messages:
Emily: Vendor ACME Labs submitted INV-10234 but the bank applied 30% US withholding at payout. They uploaded a W-8BEN-E but AP saw withholding on the remittance. link: https://invoices.redwood/INV-10234
Carlos-vendor: We uploaded a signed W-8BEN-E but missed entering an EIN and the bank still withheld. Can Redwood gross-up the invoice so we receive the net amount we quoted?
Emily: Gross-up requests require finance + legal sign-off. First step: do we consider the W-8 valid for chapter 3 purposes if it's missing EIN? @nina?
Nina: Missing EIN can be a material omission but not always fatal if other identifiers and a treaty claim exist. However, bank withholding is a separate flow. Practically: vendor should either provide a correct W-8 or, if US taxpayer, provide a W-9.
Carlos-vendor: Getting a W-9 is possible quickly. They prefer gross-up to avoid re-issue delay.
Jake: AP policy: we do not automatically gross-up. Options: 1) vendor reissue invoice net of expected withholding, 2) vendor supplies W-9 and we reprocess/refund withheld funds (bank timelines apply), 3) gross-up only by exception with VP Finance approval. I'll put a manual hold.
Invoices-bot: Payment review hold placed on INV-10234 by @jake  reason: tax-withholding dispute  hold_until: 2026-03-30.
Emily: I'll request corrected tax docs and the vendor's preferred path (W-9 + reprocess vs reissued invoice). Carlos, please confirm ETA for W-9.
Carlos-vendor: We'll send W-9 by EOD tomorrow and confirm banking proof for the withheld amount.
Nina: If they provide W-9 and bank returns funds, AP can re-credit; we'll need proof of the refund and then re-instruct net payment. Otherwise escalation to VP Finance for any gross-up.
Legal: Noted. Keep this thread open for approvals if vendor pushes for gross-up.
Emily: Thanks — AP to wait for W-9, no gross-up while we wait.
